what: One-off index build time for each SciFact first-stage arm: the 5,183-abstract corpus embedded (or BM25-indexed) from scratch, no cache, through the adapter's own warmup(), with the model revisions the committed runs used. Each arm in its own process, one at a time, on an otherwise idle machine. Model weights were already on disk, so no download is included.
note: bge_small was first timed at 524.1 s while another job briefly shared the CPU; 480.1 s is the re-time on an idle machine. The figures these replace (bm25 0.8 s, minilm 194 s, bge_small 874 s, mpnet 1825 s, e5_base 1825 s) were from a different machine, and only three of them had a recorded source; mpnet's was a copy of e5_base's.
